name: Condensed Matter Physics
description: Structure of solid matter: concepts of real and reciprocal lattice, point groups and Brillouin zones, diffraction from periodic structure, Lau and Bragg scattering condition, structure factor, defects in crystals, thermal properties of solid: specific heat, Boltzmann, Einstein, and Debye theory, phonons, lattice vibrations and dispersion in monoatomic and diatomic chain. Electrons in metals: Drude and Sommerfeld theory, density of states, Fermi-Dirac distribution, charge carrier density and conductivity in semiconductors, band dispersion, effective mass, Bloch function, Kronig Penny model. Atomic origin of magnetism: diamagnetism, Langevin theory of paramagnetism, spontaneous magnetic order, magnetic domains and anisotropy. Superconductivity: magnetic and thermodynamics of phase transitions, types of superconductors, London theory, coherence length, BCS theory of superconductivity (qualitative), brief introduction to high temperature superconductors.
